questions.prompt: Thread A locks account x and waits for y. Thread B locks y and waits for x. What happens?
options: Python raises a race condition error

questions.prompt: Deadlock requires several conditions at once, so breaking any one of them prevents it.

options: Always lock the account with the lower id first

questions.prompt: What do databases do when row locks deadlock?
options: Detect the cycle and abort one transaction, which the application must retry
